#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require "optparse"

verbose = false

parser = OptionParser.new do |opts|
  opts.banner = "Usage: #{$PROGRAM_NAME} [--verbose] FILENAME"

  opts.on("-v", "--verbose", "Also print the number of lines") do
    verbose = true
  end
end

begin
  args = parser.parse(ARGV)
rescue OptionParser::ParseError => e
  warn e.message
  warn parser
  exit 1
end

filename = args.shift
unless filename && args.empty?
  warn parser
  exit 1
end

begin
  contents = File.read(filename)
rescue SystemCallError => e
  warn "#{$PROGRAM_NAME}: #{e.message}"
  exit 1
end

puts "Words: #{contents.split.size}"
puts "Lines: #{contents.lines.count}" if verbose
